task.description: Implement SVC-04 admin UI per src/design/svc-01-04-service-scope.md. Create a Services admin page accessible to platform-admin users showing: service_id, scope, endpoint_url, timeout_ms, max_retries columns; platform-admins also see owner_tenant (display name) column and a Register Service button that opens a form. Tenant-admin users see the page in read-only mode (no register button). Implement under web/src/pages/admin/ServicesPage.tsx. Add route to the admin layout. Use the existing API client and query key factory. npm run type-check, npm run lint, npm run build must all exit 0. Commit to feature/WF02-svc-batch1-20260610.
acceptance_criteria: ServicesPage.tsx renders service list via GET /api/v1/services (tenant admin) or GET /api/v1/admin/services (platform-admin)
Columns: service_id, scope, endpoint_url, timeout_ms, max_retries
Platform-admin sees owner_tenant column and Register Service button
Tenant-admin sees the page without register button (role-based, not just hidden)
